name: Mafatlal Industries Ltd
about: The Company is engaged in textile manufacturing and trading, having its manufacturing units at Nadiad and Navsari.[1]
keyPoints:
History
The co. is a 120-year-old textile manufacturing player in India and part of Arvind Mafatlal Group founded by Mr. Mafatlal Gagalbhai. [1]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 45.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 83.5 to 62.3 days.
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 8.39% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.33.8 Cr.
